, Reason for Mistake: The Planner compared the directors’ ages at film release (39 vs 34) instead of their birth years and then inverted the logic. Gus Van Sant was born in 1952 and Massimo Ceccherini in 1965; since 1965 is later than 1952, Lucignolo is the correct answer, not My Own Private Idaho.
